{# Connect Diagnostics - Sales Order Print Format DocType: Sales Order Standardized layout aligned with the current CD Purchase Receipt / Quotation family. Main ERPNext fields used: - customer, customer_name - shipping_address, contact_display, contact_phone, contact_mobile - transaction_date, delivery_date - po_no, po_date - sales_team, territory, payment_terms_template - currency, shipping_rule - items: item_code, item_name, description, qty, uom, delivery_date, rate, discount_percentage, discount_amount, amount - total, discount_amount, net_total, taxes, grand_total, rounded_total, in_words Customer-facing policy: - Warehouse and Selling Price List are intentionally not printed. - Terms are not silently truncated into Remarks. - Per-item Delivery Date / Quotation reference are kept inline only. Optional custom-field fallback: - custom_delivery_by / delivery_by - custom_remarks / remarks #} {%- set print_context = get_document_print_context(doc, "sales_order") -%} {%- set print_date = print_context.show_date -%} {%- macro money(v) -%} {{- "{:,.2f}".format((v or 0) | float) -}} {%- endmacro -%} {%- macro qty(v) -%} {{- "{:,.2f}".format((v or 0) | float) -}} {%- endmacro -%} {# ========================================================= DOCUMENT DATA ========================================================= #} {%- set sales_persons = [] -%} {%- for sp in (doc.sales_team or []) -%} {%- if sp.sales_person and sp.sales_person not in sales_persons -%} {%- set _ = sales_persons.append(sp.sales_person) -%} {%- endif -%} {%- endfor -%} {%- set customer_name = print_context.customer_name or doc.customer_name or doc.customer or "" -%} {%- set contact_name = doc.contact_display or doc.contact_person or "" -%} {%- set contact_phone = doc.contact_mobile or doc.contact_phone or "" -%} {%- set payment_terms = doc.payment_terms_template or "" -%} {%- if not payment_terms and doc.payment_schedule -%} {%- set first_payment = doc.payment_schedule[0] -%} {%- if first_payment.get("credit_days") -%} {%- set payment_terms = (first_payment.get("credit_days") | string) ~ " วัน / Days" -%} {%- endif -%} {%- endif -%} {%- if not payment_terms -%} {%- set payment_terms = "เงินสด / Cash" -%} {%- endif -%} {%- set delivery_by = doc.get("custom_delivery_by") or doc.get("delivery_by") or doc.shipping_rule or "" -%} {%- set remarks_text = doc.get("custom_remarks") or doc.get("remarks") or "" -%} {%- set item_pages = (doc.items or []) | batch(9) | list -%} {%- if not item_pages -%} {%- set item_pages = [[]] -%} {%- endif -%} {# Separate VAT from other taxes/charges. #} {%- set tax = namespace(vat_amount=0, vat_rate=0, other_amount=0) -%} {%- for row in (doc.taxes or []) -%} {%- set tax_label = ((row.description or "") ~ " " ~ (row.account_head or "")) -%} {%- set row_tax_amount = row.get("tax_amount_after_discount_amount") if row.get("tax_amount_after_discount_amount") is not none else row.tax_amount -%} {%- set row_tax_amount = (row_tax_amount or 0) | float -%} {%- if "vat" in (tax_label | lower) or "output tax" in (tax_label | lower) or "ภาษีมูลค่าเพิ่ม" in tax_label or "ภาษีขาย" in tax_label -%} {%- set tax.vat_amount = tax.vat_amount + row_tax_amount -%} {%- if not tax.vat_rate and row.rate -%} {%- set tax.vat_rate = row.rate -%} {%- endif -%} {%- else -%} {%- set tax.other_amount = tax.other_amount + row_tax_amount -%} {%- endif -%} {%- endfor -%} {%- set grand_total_display = doc.grand_total -%} {%- if not doc.disable_rounded_total and doc.rounded_total is not none -%} {%- set grand_total_display = doc.rounded_total -%} {%- endif -%} {# ========================================================= COPIES + ITEM PAGES ========================================================= #} {%- for copy in print_context.copies -%} {%- set copy_loop = loop -%} {%- for page_items in item_pages -%} {%- set page_loop = loop -%} {%- set is_last_item_page = page_loop.last -%} {%- set is_last_print_page = copy_loop.last and page_loop.last -%} {%- set page_item_count = page_items | length -%} {%- set filler_mm = 83.20 - (page_item_count * 8.15) -%} {%- if filler_mm < 1.00 -%}{%- set filler_mm = 1.00 -%}{%- endif -%}
